purpose: Measured physical gesture mismatch and Fx0 profile tuning

physical_before_tuning.contact_durations: All below 200 ms; not the 800 ms recognizer timeout
physical_before_tuning.default_constraints: 125px travel; 50px edge band; 15 degree axis tolerance
physical_before_tuning.observation: Long swipes stop outside the narrow edge band; near-edge contacts travel less than the distance threshold. Several otherwise vertical trajectories slant about20 degrees.

profile.compositor_calibration: Identity; board DT handles both axis inversions

trace_replay.kind: Synthetic EVDEV replay of measured physical trajectories/timings; not a physical acceptance result
trace_replay.default_down_up: Keyboard remains visible after both; reproduces failure
trace_replay.slanted_trace_with_angle_tuning: Closes then reopens on installed r3

physical_after_tuning: Owner confirms typing and both keyboard close/open gestures on installed native r3; nine real touch contacts, no drops/stuck contacts. Independent GPIO capture confirms all three buttons.
UI_scope: Pixman, full Sxmo test session, audio/modem/idle/suspend still disabled
verbose_tracing: Removed after the physical test; running recognizer retains60px/120px/25degree settings
